title: David D Probable NDE 9985
content: After my son's death, I took epilepsy medication. During this time, I had several visions of a beautiful yard with blue tinted colors. I was enjoying perfection with nature. I had another vision of standing in a street of an old western town. I saw a Being in a run-down house. I was brain dead for 4 minutes and in a coma for 8 days. I was back to almost normal within a month. This has changed my whole outlook on life, but I still have so many questions. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: August 2023 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Suicide attempt CPR given Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes Several times, I heard three voices, two were women and one was a man. Although I never saw them, I can tell you the height, weight, and hair color of each person. How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt peacefulness and beauty without words. There was no hate. This experience was as real as life itself. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? not sure Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I saw beautiful colors, leaves, and treesthat were all full of energy. I wanted to stay, but my wife needed me more Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. no sound Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt pure contentment. I wasn't married, a father or a friend. Yet, I felt was pure love for all things and peace beyond peace. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt no longer in conflict with nature Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Buddhist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Buddhist Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I didn't have any religion in my life Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes more respect for life. Being good so that I can earn my place there. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify. 2 women,1 man. All were soft-spoken Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes I know what the great beyond means; it's joy and peace. During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? Yes I want to go back. During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The colors were almost electrifying. I was in an area where I felt that I belonged What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life. I respect all life, from a blade of grass to a human being. I won't even kill a fly without feeling guilty Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? closer to my wife After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I can't totally explain it, but there was no hate in relationships. I was happier there than I have ever been. How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. It was like being in the Garden of Eden Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? all of it Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I try to talk to anyone who would listen. But there are few. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. It was as real as my house What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. It was real. I explained what I was wearing during my coma At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes only aura visions during and before seizure Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? no mgmu2qk_nde

arrival.other_being_detail: Narrative mentions: 'I saw a Being in a run-down house' (in an old western town vision), but NDERF item responses also state: 'Did you see any beings in your experience? No.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful yard with blue-tinted colors; 'beautiful colors, leaves, and trees that were all full of energy'; compared to 'Garden of Eden'. Also a vision of a street in an old western town.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Visions of a beautiful yard with blue-tinted colors; old western town street; 'no hate'; 'Garden of Eden'. Heard three voices (2 women, 1 man) without seeing them.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience described as occurring while taking epilepsy medication after son's death; reports 'several visions' (yard; old western town). Heard three soft-spoken voices without seeing them but believed he could describe their physical characteristics. States he was 'brain dead for 4 minutes' and in coma 8 days; returned to almost normal within a month.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt peacefulness and beauty without words. There was no hate.”; “I saw beautiful colors, leaves, and trees that were all full of energy.”; “I wanted to stay, but my wife needed me more.”; “It was like being in the Garden of Eden.”
